n_balanced_sample.definition: main sample also observed at k=12 and k=24

n_control_games.definition: ranked 2016-10 with >=500 raters, present in every snapshot

change_12.definition: mean change in displayed average from entry to month 12

change_24.definition: mean change in displayed average from entry to month 24

change_36.definition: mean change in displayed average from entry to month 36

share_of_decline_by_12.definition: mean change_12 / mean change_36 (game-level bootstrap CI)

median_change_36.definition: median change from entry to month 36

change_36_rater_weighted.definition: mean change_36 weighted by raters at month 36

examples_min_raters.definition: minimum raters at month 36 for the example games

gap_k3.definition: mean of (new_avg_3 - avg_rating) at k=3, usable rows, equal weight per row

gap_k6.definition: mean of (new_avg_3 - avg_rating) at k=6, usable rows, equal weight per row

gap_k12.definition: mean of (new_avg_3 - avg_rating) at k=12, usable rows, equal weight per row

gap_k24.definition: mean of (new_avg_3 - avg_rating) at k=24, usable rows, equal weight per row

gap_k36.definition: mean of (new_avg_3 - avg_rating) at k=36, usable rows, equal weight per row

control_drift_36.definition: mean control-group change over each main-sample game's own 36-month window

change_36_control_adjusted.definition: mean of change_36 minus control change over the same calendar months

control_change_full_period.definition: control-group mean average, last month minus 2016-10

change_36_hype_q1.definition: mean change_36, hype quartile 1 (1 = least hyped)

change_36_hype_q2.definition: mean change_36, hype quartile 2 (1 = least hyped)

change_36_hype_q3.definition: mean change_36, hype quartile 3 (1 = least hyped)

change_36_hype_q4.definition: mean change_36, hype quartile 4 (1 = least hyped)

rater_growth_m6_by_hype_q1.definition: mean of raters_m6 / raters_m0, hype quartile 1

rater_growth_median_m6_by_hype_q1.definition: median of raters_m6 / raters_m0, hype quartile 1

entry_rater_share_m36_by_hype_q1.definition: median of raters_m0 / raters_m36: share of month-36 raters who were the entry batch, hype quartile 1

gap_k36_by_hype_q1.definition: mean new-rater minus displayed average at k=36, hype quartile 1

rater_growth_m6_by_hype_q2.definition: mean of raters_m6 / raters_m0, hype quartile 2

rater_growth_median_m6_by_hype_q2.definition: median of raters_m6 / raters_m0, hype quartile 2

entry_rater_share_m36_by_hype_q2.definition: median of raters_m0 / raters_m36: share of month-36 raters who were the entry batch, hype quartile 2

gap_k36_by_hype_q2.definition: mean new-rater minus displayed average at k=36, hype quartile 2

rater_growth_m6_by_hype_q3.definition: mean of raters_m6 / raters_m0, hype quartile 3

rater_growth_median_m6_by_hype_q3.definition: median of raters_m6 / raters_m0, hype quartile 3

entry_rater_share_m36_by_hype_q3.definition: median of raters_m0 / raters_m36: share of month-36 raters who were the entry batch, hype quartile 3

gap_k36_by_hype_q3.definition: mean new-rater minus displayed average at k=36, hype quartile 3

rater_growth_m6_by_hype_q4.definition: mean of raters_m6 / raters_m0, hype quartile 4

rater_growth_median_m6_by_hype_q4.definition: median of raters_m6 / raters_m0, hype quartile 4

entry_rater_share_m36_by_hype_q4.definition: median of raters_m0 / raters_m36: share of month-36 raters who were the entry batch, hype quartile 4

gap_k36_by_hype_q4.definition: mean new-rater minus displayed average at k=36, hype quartile 4

share_rank_improved_36.definition: share of main-sample games with rank_m36 < rank_m0 (rank improved)

avg_rank100.definition: median raw average of games ranked 90-110 in the end-month snapshot

avg_rank1000.definition: median raw average of games ranked 990-1010 in the end-month snapshot

fade_share_of_rank_gap.definition: |change_36| divided by the average gap between games ranked ~100 and ~1000
